text:
Scale: the square plate measures about 455 px across, which I took as roughly 26 cm. That gives about 17 px per cm.

There are three cheese pizza pieces:
- Top piece: about 150 px by 130 px, or roughly 8 × 7 cm. It is about 1 cm thick, so about 55 cm³. At a density of about 0.6 g/cm³ that is roughly 40 g.
- Right piece: a triangle with sides of about 8 cm and 6 cm, so about 25 cm² of area. At about 1 cm thick that is 25 cm³, or roughly 40 g.
- Bottom piece: about 9 × 6 cm, or 50 cm² of area. At about 1 cm thick that is 50 cm³, or roughly 45 g.

Together that is about 125 g of pizza. Cheese pizza runs about 270 kcal per 100 g.

The plate at the left edge holds a taco, but it is mostly out of frame, so I left it out.
